class.name: GameVoice
class.brief_description: Opt-in push-to-talk and authority-routed voice for one Steam game.
class.description: Resolve the persistent service with [method GameRuntime.voice]. The game owns input, user consent and playback. Voice uses an unreliable ordered lane for the current mounted world and accepts only authenticated, world-ready participants. The authority filters recipients and limits sender and relay bandwidth. Local mute removes queued playback without changing the sender's access.

method.name: start_talking
method.description: Requests local microphone capture after explicit opt-in. Requires a ready Steam participant in an online world. An occupied process microphone returns [constant ERR_BUSY].

method.name: stop_talking
method.description: Stops transmitting immediately and requests native capture stop. Any final native audio is discarded by the capture scope.

method.name: set_muted
method.description: Mutes or unmutes one remote session-local peer on this client. Muting removes queued frames and ends its displayed speaking state.

method.name: set_channel
method.description: Selects the requested channel for future local frames. The game authority evaluates the channel and recipient policy before any remote delivery.

method.name: set_recipient_policy
method.description: Configures trusted authority code accepting sender peer ID, recipient peer ID and channel and returning a boolean. An empty callable enables group delivery to eligible peers only. Supply authority-owned team or proximity state when filtering those channels.

method.name: _voice_submit
method.description: Internal unreliable ordered transport entry point. The authority takes sender identity from the actual multiplayer context and rejects stale or unauthorized frames.

method.name: _voice_receive
method.description: Internal authority-only delivery entry point. Accepts the attributed sender only from the current authenticated authority and applies local mute and queue limits.

signal.name: talking_changed
signal.description: Emitted when explicit local capture changes or decoded remote audio begins, goes idle, is muted, or leaves the current world.

signal.name: frame_received
signal.description: Emitted with authorized decoded signed 16-bit mono samples for one remote peer. Feed them to the game's playback queue at the reported rate.

constants.constant: Deliver to eligible group participants under the authority policy.
Require an explicit team recipient policy.
Require an explicit proximity recipient policy.
